newsitem.title: UK: Allied Domecq leads UK drinks shares higher.
newsitem.headline: Allied Domecq leads UK drinks shares higher.

text.p: Shares in Allied Domecq Plc led British drinks shares higher on Wednesday as good buying interest boosted the sector, dealers said.
Allied shares were 17p firmer at 462-1/2 by 1308 GMT, while Grand Metropolitan Plc gained six pence to 486 and Guinness Plc climbed 10-1/2p to 515-1/2.
"The whole sector is looking good," one dealer said. "Some of the shares have taken a bit of a drop recently and people are looking at them again."
Dealers said the sector was also helped by figures showing a modest rise in Scotch whisky exports in 1996.
Exports totalled 2.278 billion stg, up from 2.277 billion in 1995, the Scotch Whisky Association said.
